description: Fictional Hinglish and mixed-language customer messages with the promise or payment claim a careful reader would extract. Used to measure language coverage before adding such messages to the reviewed catalogue.

items.message: Bhai 50,000 Friday tak transfer kar dunga.
Payment kar diya hai, ref UTR-DEMO-9 check karo.
Abhi cash flow tight hai, next week tak 20,000 bhej denge.
Sir 1,20,000 ka poora payment kal hi ho gaya tha.
Project review ke baad baat karte hain, abhi kuch confirm nahi kar sakte.
Mahine ke end tak INR 35,000 clear kar denge, promise.
Humne 10,000 advance diya tha na, woh adjust kar lo.
Diwali se pehle baaki amount de dunga.
